### Finding the Lost Sheep
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-april-21-2005-1325214.html
Passage: Luke 15:6
Points:
- Jesus crossed a stormy sea to rescue a tormented man, illustrating the Shepherd pursuing His lost sheep.
- The enemy works constantly to destroy lives and obstruct Christ's mission.
- No obstacle or fierce resistance can stop Jesus from reaching those who are lost.
- Satan's efforts to thwart Christ's redeeming power will always end in defeat.

### The Lord’s Care for His Own
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lords-care-his-own
Passage: Matthew 18:14
Points:
- Christians must reject spiritual pride and never look down on fellow believers with contempt.
- God and His heavenly angels maintain constant, vigilant care over every child of the kingdom.
- The Father’s love extends to each individual sheep, ensuring none of His own are abandoned to perish.
- Believers and church leaders are called to reflect God’s heart by lovingly restoring wandering brothers and sisters.
